model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 46164 Westlake Drive in Sterling, Virginia, as the Firefighter Trevor Brown Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Suhas Subramanyam (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would rename a U.S. Postal Service facility in Sterling, Virginia in honor of Firefighter Trevor Brown.
